verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents data residency or a storage-region choice. Mentions of domestic acquiring coverage in 45+ countries and US direct acquiring concern payment processing reach, not where customer data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
